verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents ingestion via Events API v2 and 750+ monitoring integrations, with dedup/orchestration rules and escalation policies/schedules that let SREs define routing conditions to the right team (docs-31,37,43,50). Community feedback corroborates escalation working well in practice (comm-1) though notes some friction with identity/config setup (comm-4) unrelated to core routing logic. Missing for 10: independent large-scale validation of complex condition-based routing accuracy and resolution of the noted API versioning confusion (comm-6).
